features: Explosion-proof: cFMus Class I/II/III Division 1 (Groups B, C, D, E, F, G), IECEx & ATEX Zone 1/21 (IIB+H2/IIIC)
Marine-grade aluminum housing made in USA, NEMA 4X
AI object detection (person, face, vehicle, license plate), IVA, BestShot
AI people counting, queue management, heatmap
Original view 3008x3008, double panorama 3584x1792, single panorama 3584x896, quad view
Built-in mic, selectable mic/line in, line out; 2 configurable alarm I/O
ONVIF Profile S/G/T/M, SUNAPI, Wisenet Open Platform
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision datasheet (DataSheet_TNM-XNF9013EPT3-Z_260101_EN.pdf). Operating temperature is the certified hazardous-area range stated for the housing (-20 to +55C); the spec table lists -40 to +60C for the camera. Field of view omitted: the datasheet's 'H: 209/180, V: 83' row appears copied from the TNM-P9022 panoramic model. PoE class text is inconsistent (802.3at listed with Class 3), so no class recorded. Dimensions not stated.

frigate.notes: Hanwha profiles: profile1=MJPEG, profile2=main, profile3=sub (default Wisenet profile layout); not yet verified on this model.
